facts.fact: The IFJ, RSF, AFIC, FAJ and NUSOJ joint statement says the Official Information Bill was passed by the Council of Ministers in March 2024 and forwarded to the House of the People of the Federal Parliament.

SOM.note: Secret drafting complaint concerns an access to information bill, which is not a digital law or policy.
Only compares the bill to the African Union Model Law; no signature, ratification or national law giving effect to a shared digital text.
